question: What is the primary underlying cause of inherited degenerative disorders?

options.B: Acute physical trauma to the brain

explanation: These disorders stem directly from inherited flaws or mutations within the genetic code that disrupt normal cellular function. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h1)

question: Why is nursing care for inherited degenerative disorders focused on comfort rather than a cure?

options.A: Medications can completely reverse the genetic mutation if given early.
options.B: Hospital policies restrict long-term curative therapies for chronic illnesses.
options.C: The underlying genetic damage causes progressive and irreversible cell death.
options.D: Clients usually recover spontaneously once they reach middle age.

explanation: Because these conditions involve continuous cellular breakdown from genetics, treatment focuses on managing symptoms and keeping the patient as comfortable as possible. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h1)

question: Which diagnostic test is commonly used to measure electrical activity in muscles and nerves for these clients?
explanation: Electromyography helps clinicians evaluate the health of muscles and the nerve cells that control them. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h2)

question: A client with an inherited degenerative disorder shows early muscle weakness and clumsy coordination. What should you do first?

options.A: Prepare the client for emergency surgery to repair the damaged genes
options.B: Document the findings, report the progression to the healthcare team, and assess safety needs
options.C: Tell the family that these mild symptoms will completely disappear within a week
options.D: Advise the client to stop all physical movement immediately to prevent further weakness

explanation: Spotting these changes early and planning for safety helps protect the client from falls as their motor skills decline. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h2)

question: Why do clients with inherited degenerative disorders need a team of different specialists (multidisciplinary team)?

options.A: Hospital regulations require at least five different specialists for every chronic illness.
options.B: It lowers the cost of hospital care by eliminating the need for registered nurses.
options.C: The disease progressively affects multiple body systems, requiring diverse specialized expertise.
options.D: Specialists can completely cure the genetic mutation if they work together.

explanation: As different body systems break down over time, various health professionals are needed to team up for physical, nutritional, and emotional support. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h3)

question: What is a primary treatment goal for clients with inherited degenerative disorders?

options.A: Eliminating the need for any family involvement
options.B: Maintaining the highest possible level of independence and comfort
options.C: Reversing the genetic mutation through intense physical exercise
options.D: Achieving a complete cure within six months of diagnosis

explanation: Since a cure is not available, goals focus on maximizing quality of life, function, and comfort. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h3)

question: What is the main purpose of giving medications to clients with inherited degenerative disorders?

options.A: To prevent family members from developing the same condition
options.B: To completely repair the damaged DNA inside the cells
options.C: To relieve specific symptoms and improve day-to-day comfort
options.D: To permanently stop the natural progression of the disease

explanation: Medications target troubling symptoms like spasms, pain, and stiffness to make the client more comfortable. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h4)

question: Which type of medication is commonly prescribed to ease painful muscle stiffness and spasms?
explanation: Muscle relaxants help reduce spasticity and the painful cramping associated with progressive neurological damage. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h4)

question: Which professional helps a client adapt their living space by introducing tools like customized eating utensils?
explanation: Occupational therapists specialize in helping clients adapt their daily activities and living spaces to maintain their independence. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h5)

question: Why is physical therapy so important for a client with a progressive muscle-wasting disorder?

options.A: It replaces the need for any medications or assistive devices.
options.B: It cures the genetic defect causing the muscle weakness.
options.C: It rebuilds destroyed muscle fibers back to their original strength.
options.D: It helps maintain joint flexibility and prevents painful contractures.

explanation: Gentle stretching and range-of-motion exercises keep joints flexible and prevent muscles and tendons from painfully shortening. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h5)

question: What is the medical term for difficulty swallowing experienced by many clients with degenerative disorders?
explanation: Dysphagia refers to impaired swallowing mechanics caused by muscle weakness or neurological damage. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h6)

question: A client with severe difficulty swallowing (dysphagia) just finished a meal in bed. What is your most important immediate action?

options.A: Brush the client's teeth while they lie flat on their back
options.B: Lay the client flat immediately to help with digestion
options.C: Keep the head of the bed elevated for at least 30 minutes
options.D: Encourage the client to drink a large glass of thin water quickly

explanation: Keeping the head elevated prevents food or liquid from flowing back up and entering the airway, which lowers the risk of choking or aspiration. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h6)

question: What is the main purpose of genetic counseling for families affected by these disorders?

options.A: To provide daily physical therapy for weakened muscles
options.B: To prescribe medication for muscle spasms and pain
options.C: To perform surgical procedures that repair damaged genes
options.D: To explain inheritance risks and guide family planning decisions

explanation: Genetic counselors help families understand how a condition is passed down and discuss testing options for other relatives. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h7)

question: Why is emotional and psychological support just as crucial as physical care for these clients?

options.A: Coping with a progressive, incurable disease often leads to depression and anxiety.
options.B: Clients with degenerative disorders never experience physical pain.
options.C: Emotional stress can directly reverse the genetic mutation in the DNA.
options.D: Psychological counseling replaces the need for any nutritional support.

explanation: Watching one's body slowly fail creates a heavy mental burden, making compassionate psychological support essential. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h7)

question: What is the primary focus of palliative care in the final stages of an inherited degenerative disorder?

options.A: Testing family members for the presence of the gene
options.B: Finding a new experimental cure to reverse the disease
options.C: Maximizing comfort, managing pain, and preserving dignity
options.D: Increasing physical therapy sessions to restore lost muscle

explanation: Palliative care prioritizes comfort, relieving symptoms, and providing emotional support when life expectancy is limited. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h8)

question: A client with a terminal degenerative disorder can still speak clearly. When should you discuss advance directives and end-of-life wishes with them?

options.A: While the client is still capable of making and expressing their own decisions
options.B: Never, because family members should make all healthcare choices
options.C: Only after the client loses consciousness in the final hours of life
options.D: During the initial diagnostic blood test before the disease is explained

explanation: It is best to discuss advance directives early while the client is still of sound mind to ensure their personal wishes are truly honored. [learn more](GNS222_U4_T15#GNS222_U4_T15_h8)
